title: SPE Chapter 09 - Blog: A Markdown Content Engine (Posts, Docs, Tags)
description:
Chapter 09 of Simple PHP Engine - the finished application, built entirely from the pieces of the earlier chapters.

This tutorial covers:
• One posts table + a Type enum (Post, Doc) — Blog and Docs share one Content plugin
• A small, safe Markdown renderer (escape-before-parse, URL-scheme allowlist)
• Post as a value object with property hooks (html and excerpt computed on read)
• Many-to-many tags with filtering and pagination
• Prev/next and oldest/newest via array_first() / array_last()
• Self-hosted docs: the engine serves the very tutorial that describes it
